text:
lee: quick quiet-window ping — smoke + canary before we cut traffic. short checklist below, pls reply with ack or issues.

lee: quick checklist:
• release notes posted (internal) -> https://redwood.infer/releases/3.5.0-internal
• canary pinned in prod-shadow and staging to v3.5.0
• rollback guardrails: 5% error OR 300ms p95 for 3m
• fallback model available v3.4.x-compat
• cache warmup plan for edge pools
• oncall + SRE present

toni: ack. i'll warm cache and watch token-level latency.

sam: i'll run synthetic traffic (small batch) to eu/us and monitor mem & cpu.

deploy-bot: action: canary-check staging v3.5.0 -> OK
deploy-bot: action: canary-check prod-shadow v3.5.0 -> OK
lee: starting unpin for low-traffic cohort (slice-1, 3%). toni you own cache warmup.

deploy-bot: Running: `deploy unpin --slice slice-1 --model v3.5.0 --by lee`
deploy-bot: Result: UNPIN OK (slice-1 -> traffic 0.03)

sam: synthetic run in eu-west-1 started. initial perf looks fine.

toni: cache warmup running: `cache fill --pool edge-eu-west-1 --keys 1k`

ops-bot: metric alert suppression applied for 5m during warmup window per request from lee.

sam: hmmm seeing increasing RSS on a subset of nodes in eu-west-1 after ~90s, trending up. p95 latency +80ms.

lee: can you paste samples? sounds like potential mem leak or bad batch shaping.

sam: logs: `pythonOOM: Alloc failed at kv_cache.py line 214` and GC spikes. attaching minimal snippet.

deploy-bot: route health: eu-west-1 partial degrade -> 4% of requests falling back to v3.4.x-compat automatically.

toni: is this only on machines with accelerated cache path? If so we can toggle cache-mmap-offload.

irene-oncall: i'm on pagerduty, ready to escalate. what are rollback cut points?

lee: decision matrix: if error >=5% for 3m -> rollback full slice; if p95 > 300ms -> pause rollout. For mem leaks if it's a subset, we can toggle cache off for eu region and continue. Thoughts?

sam: agree. try toggling cache off in eu-west-1 to see if memory stabilizes. that avoids full rollback.

toni: ops shortcut: `ops toggle-cache-offload --region eu-west-1` — takes 40s. I can run.

lee: do it. sam keep watching. irene keep PD monitoring.

deploy-bot: ops action requested: `ops toggle-cache-offload --region eu-west-1`
deploy-bot: ops result: OK -> cache offload disabled in eu-west-1 at 14:07:41 UTC

sam: RSS dropping back to normal within 45s. p95 back to baseline. errors falling to 0.8%.

lee: good. hold rollout for 10m while infra investigates. create infra ticket for cache offload compatibility.

toni: filed ticket INF-2026-2481 with traces and node list. tagging infra team.

irene-oncall: monitoring in place for 30m. escalation if spike.

lee: update to release notes: note about eu-west cache offload toggle during rollout + mitigation steps. also add owner for postmortem followup.

deploy-bot: summary: canary v3.5.0 partial roll -> slice-1 unpinned -> transient mem rise in eu-west-1 -> cache offload toggled -> stabilized. No rollback performed.

sam: next steps: after 10m stable, unpin slice-2 (20%) and continue conservative rollout. i'll do an expanded synthetic run during that window.

toni: ack. will re-enable warmup for new slice after unpin.

lee: thanks all. leaving thread open until full rollout complete. post final close here. :slightly_smiling_face:

(automated) deploy-bot: thread will auto-archive in 45m unless activity continues.
